name: HIPAA Critical (Strong Signature and Clinical Document)
description: Engine 1. High-confidence PHI with a strong identity anchor; single record reportable. Three pathways: (1) Medical Document or Medical Imaging classifier + identifier; (2) Medical Information context with clinical density (Drugs > 4, Diseases > 2, Treatments > 4, or an NDC code) + identifier; (3) clinical-narrative structure (> 3 markers) with clinical content + identifier.
expression: ((((D:Medical Document > 0) OR (D:Medical Imaging > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))) OR ((D:Medical Information > 0) AND ((D:Drugs Information > 4) OR (D:Diseases Information > 2) OR (D:Treatments Information > 4) OR (D:NDC Number (Package) > 0) OR (D:NDC Number (Product) > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))) OR ((D:Custom-Clinical-Narrative > 3) AND ((D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Drugs Information > 0) OR (D:Treatments Information > 0)) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Names (US) > 0))))

name: HIPAA Narrative - Low Volume
description: Engine 2. Short-form clinical content (referral letters, prior authorizations, prescription notes) that will not reach Engine 1's density: clinical terms > 2 with a name and a second identifier (SSN, DOB, MRN or member id).
expression: (((D:Diseases Information > 2) OR (D:Drugs Information > 2) OR (D:Treatments Information > 2)) AND (D:Names (US) > 0) AND ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)))

name: HIPAA Identity Trifecta
description: Engine 3. Identity-theft-grade combinations independent of clinical content, reportable under most state breach laws: strict trifecta (SSN + DOB + name) or the expanded branch (name + DOB + driver's licence, enhanced driver's licence or TIN). Without a DOB the expanded branch never fires.
expression: (((D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) AND (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) AND (D:Names (US) > 0)) OR ((D:Names (US) > 0) AND (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) AND ((D:Driver's License (United States) > 0) OR (D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States) > 0) OR (D:Tax Identification Number (US) > 0))))

name: HIPAA Sensitive Subcategory
description: Engine 4. Mental health, substance use disorder (42 CFR Part 2), HIV, genetic (GINA) and reproductive PHI beside an identifier: elevated handling, restricted reviewer queue. Terms and gene names from the custom markers, ICD-10 codes from Diseases Information, informal language from Self-Harm & Cyberbullying and Illegal Drugs.
expression: (((D:Custom-Sensitive-Condition-Markers > 0) OR (D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Self-Harm & Cyberbullying > 0) OR (D:Illegal Drugs > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)))

name: HIPAA Pharmacy - Claims - Billing
description: Engine 5. Pharmacy pathway: drug evidence (Drugs > 2 or an NDC code) + identifier + a provider or narrative anchor (NPI or clinical narrative). Claims pathway: billing density (> 2 billing phrases) or the Insurance Document classifier + clinical evidence + identifier (including a card number on a claim document; the clinical gate keeps pure payments out).
expression: ((((D:Drugs Information > 2) OR (D:NDC Number (Package) > 0) OR (D:NDC Number (Product) > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0)) AND ((D:National Provider Identifier > 0) OR (D:Custom-Clinical-Narrative > 0))) OR (((D:Custom-Insurance-Billing > 2) OR (D:Insurance Document > 0)) AND ((D:Diseases Information > 0) OR (D:Treatments Information > 0)) AND ((D:Names (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number > 0) OR (D:Custom-Date-of-Birth > 0) OR (D:Social Security Numbers (US) > 0) OR (D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier > 0) OR (D:Credit Cards > 0))))

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Small
description: Engine 6, small tier: the Sum of identifier matches (SSN, MRN, member id, NPI, TIN, driver's licence, enhanced driver's licence) above 1, i.e. any multi-record exposure. The Engine Builder's Sum operator, as the build specifies; the tiers differ only in the threshold.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) + D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number + D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier + D:National Provider Identifier + D:Tax Identification Number (US) + D:Driver's License (United States) + D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States)) > 1)

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Significant
description: Engine 6, significant tier: the same Sum of identifier matches above 50. Executive escalation; still under the 500-individual notification threshold.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) + D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number + D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier + D:National Provider Identifier + D:Tax Identification Number (US) + D:Driver's License (United States) + D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States)) > 50)

name: HIPAA Bulk PHI - Major
description: Engine 6, MAJOR tier: the same Sum of identifier matches above 500, a potential 500+ individual breach; routes straight to the Privacy Officer, legal counsel and executive incident response.
expression: ((D:Social Security Numbers (US) + D:Custom-Medical-Record-Number + D:Custom-Health-Plan-Member-Identifier + D:National Provider Identifier + D:Tax Identification Number (US) + D:Driver's License (United States) + D:Enhanced Driver's License (United States)) > 500)

name: HIPAA US PII
description: Engine 7 (from the Fed pack's US PII engine, plus passports). Personally identifiable information outside a clinical context: five or more SSNs, TINs, alien registration or passport numbers, any one of them within 500 bytes of its label, or a date of birth with five or more driver's licence numbers. Catches the identity data a covered entity holds on patients, members and staff that is reportable under state breach law even when no diagnosis travels with it.
expression: ((D:HC-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:HC-Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:HC-Tax Identification Number (US) - High > 4) OR (D:HC-Tax Identification Number (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:HC-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:HC-Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0) OR ((D:HC-Date of Birth - High Confidence > 1) AND (D:HC-Drivers License (United States) - High > 4)) OR (D:HC-US Passport - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:HC-US Passport - Prox 500 > 0))

name: HIPAA US PHI - Medium Confidence
description: Engine 8 (from the Fed pack's US PHI - Medium Confidence). Medical content (Medical Document, or Medical Information with ten or more drug or disease terms) together with one identifier: an SSN, passport or alien number, or a date of birth beside a driver's licence. A second, independent PHI opinion beside Engine 1; the two are expected to overlap on real records and disagree on edge cases, which is what the tuning phase measures.
expression: (((D:Medical Document > 0) OR ((D:Medical Information > 0) AND ((D:Drugs Information > 9) OR (D:Diseases Information > 9)))) AND ((D:HC-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 0) OR (D:HC-US Passport - High Confidence > 0) OR (D:HC-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 0) OR ((D:HC-Date of Birth - High Confidence > 0) AND (D:HC-Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 0))))

name: HIPAA US PHI - High Confidence
description: Engine 9 (from the Fed pack's US PHI - High Confidence). Denser medical content (fifteen or more drug or disease terms) together with five or more identifiers, or any identifier within 500 bytes of its label. Fires on documents that are unmistakably a set of patient records.
expression: (((D:Medical Document > 0) OR ((D:Medical Information > 0) AND ((D:Drugs Information > 14) OR (D:Diseases Information > 14)))) AND ((D:HC-Social Security Numbers (US) - High > 4) OR (D:HC-US Passport - High Confidence > 4) OR (D:HC-Alien Registration Number - High Confidence > 4) OR ((D:HC-Date of Birth - Prox 500 > 1) AND (D:HC-Drivers License (United States) - Prox 500 > 1)) OR (D:HC-Social Security Numbers (US) - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:HC-US Passport - Prox 500 > 0) OR (D:HC-Alien Registration Number - Prox 500 > 0)))

name: HIPAA Financial Information
description: Engine 10 (from the Fed pack's Financial Information engine). Payment card numbers and magnetic tracks, ABA routing numbers, tax forms (W-2, 1099, K-1, 1040) and Zscaler's financial classifiers: the card and bank data a provider or payer handles on claims, billing and payroll, in scope for PCI DSS beside HIPAA.
expression: ((D:HC-ABA Bank Routing Number - High > 4) OR (D:HC-ABA Bank Routing Number - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:HC-Credit Cards - High > 4) OR (D:HC-Credit Cards - Prox 500 > 1) OR (D:HC-Credit Card Magnetic Tracks > 0) OR (D:ML_TAX_LEAKAGE > 0) OR (D:HC-Form K-1 > 3) OR (D:HC-Form 1099-MISC and 1099-NEC > 4) OR (D:HC-W2 or W4 or W9 Forms > 3) OR (D:HC-Form 1040 and related schedules > 3) OR (D:FINANCIAL > 0) OR (D:ML_CORPORATE_FINANCE_LEAKAGE > 0))
